title: Kakutani Fixed Point Theorem for Set-Valued Maps
description: Formalizes the Kakutani fixed point theorem framework: set-valued maps, upper hemicontinuity, and the main theorem for compact convex sets. Recovers Brouwer as a corollary.

meta.author: Kakutani (1941)
originalContributions: Set-valued map framework with graph, values properties
Upper hemicontinuity definition and continuous-is-UHC proof

overview.historicalContext: Kakutani (1941) generalized Brouwer's theorem to set-valued maps. Nash (1950) used it to prove existence of Nash equilibria.
overview.problemStatement: Formalize the Kakutani fixed point theorem for set-valued maps.
overview.text: Defines set-valued maps, upper hemicontinuity, and axiomatizes Kakutani's theorem. Recovers Brouwer as a corollary.
overview.proofStrategy: Defines set-valued maps, upper hemicontinuity, and axiomatizes Kakutani's theorem. Recovers Brouwer as a corollary.

conclusion.summary: Kakutani framework formalized with 1 axiom (the main theorem). Brouwer recovered as corollary. Nash equilibrium connection sketched.
openQuestions: Prove kakutani_finite_dim from Brouwer via simplicial approximation
